notes.subject: מחקי
notes.rationale: 'ol samting ol i makim long mi' (ol kaikai bilong mi — KJV, Geneva) o ' hap bilong mi' (YLT 'allotted portion'); Hebri חוק i min hap ol i givim long man

notes.subject: צפנתי
notes.rationale: 'mi hilimap' — Hebri i tok 'mi haitim olgeta olgeta olsem treasua', Tok Pisin i lusim piksa bilong haitim

translation: Komand bilong bibi bilong em, na mi no muvim ⟨mi⟩ weg; moa long olgeta kaikai bilong mi, mi hilimap olgeta ol tok bilong maun bilong em.

tokens.gloss: moa long olgeta kaikai bilong mi
